title: Trials and Growth
definition: Trials and growth teach that God can use hardship, adversity, testing, and difficulty to mature believers, strengthen faith, develop perseverance, and deepen dependence upon Him.
summary: God can use trials to mature faith and deepen dependence on Him.
christFocus: Jesus endured suffering faithfully and now uses trials to conform His people more closely to His likeness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Trials are not pleasant, and Scripture never asks believers to pretend otherwise. Yet God often uses seasons of hardship to accomplish spiritual work that prosperity cannot. Trials reveal weaknesses, expose misplaced trusts, deepen prayer, strengthen faith, develop perseverance, and teach believers to rely upon God. Though believers may not understand every reason for a trial, they can trust that God remains present and purposeful in the midst of it.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: When hardship comes, many people assume God has abandoned them or is punishing them. Understanding God's work through trials helps believers endure suffering without losing hope or faith.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask not only, "How do I escape this trial?" but also, "What is God teaching me through it?" Continue seeking God faithfully even when answers are unclear. Trust that spiritual growth often develops slowly through perseverance.
